relations.note: Atum-Khepri is jointly addressed as the self-emerging creator.
Isis names Atum and Khepri as authorities for her complaint.
Atum-Khepri emerges from Nun, the pre-existing primordial waters.
Nun raises the solar bark containing Khepri as the renewed sun.
Atum-Khepri brings Shu forth through sneezing or spitting.
Atum-Khepri produces Tefnut through spitting or expectoration.

relations.myth: Daily emergence of the solar god
relations.note: Khepri is compounded with Ra and represents Ra's emerging, renewed form.
Khepri participates in cumulative solar compounds such as Amun-Ra-Khepri.
Osiris descends from Khepri through Shu and Tefnut when Khepri is Atum-Khepri.
The nocturnal sun joins Osirian regenerative power and re-emerges as Khepri.
Geb belongs to the Ennead descending from Atum-Khepri's offspring.
Nut belongs to the Ennead descending from Atum-Khepri's offspring.
Isis descends from Khepri through Shu and Tefnut when Khepri is Atum-Khepri.

relations.myth: Isis appeals during the divine dispute
relations.note: Isis invokes Khepri in his bark as an authority for her complaint.
Seth descends from Khepri through Shu and Tefnut when Khepri is Atum-Khepri.
Nephthys descends from Khepri through Shu and Tefnut when Khepri is Atum-Khepri.
Neith and Khepri are co-invoked in Isis's appeal without direct dialogue.
Ptah-Tatenen and Khepri are co-invoked in Isis's appeal.

relations.myth: Horizon emergence of the solar Horus
relations.note: Late temple theology identifies the horizon-emerging Horus with Khepri.

relations.myth: Nocturnal passage of the solar bark
relations.note: Heka accompanies the solar passage whose renewed form is Khepri.

relations.myth: Nocturnal passage of the solar bark
relations.note: Sia accompanies the solar god whose renewed emerging form is Khepri.

relations.myth: Midnight passage in the solar bark
relations.note: Crowley's ritual places Tahuti at the prow while Khephra travels hidden.

relations.myth: Midnight passage in the solar bark
relations.note: Crowley's ritual places Ra-Hoor at the helm of Khephra's bark.

relations.myth: Attack upon the nocturnal solar passage
relations.note: Apophis obstructs the solar cycle whose successful renewed state is Khepri.
Ptah's creative intelligence incorporates the Heliopolitan Atum-Khepri complex.
